LAREDO — A 39-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail early Sunday morning on alleged felony charges of tampering with physical evidence, according to Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Roy Olivares was arrested on October 25, 2026, at 12:49 a.m. by the Laredo Police Department. The booking record lists two counts of tampering with or fabricating physical evidence with intent to impair — both third-degree felonies — along with possession of marijuana under two ounces, a Class B misdemeanor, and possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 3 under 28 grams, a Class A misdemeanor. Bond was set at $10,000 on one tampering count; bond had not been set on the remaining charges.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
